value.rationale: The motivating pure RD residual solver has no corresponding two-spectral convergence theorem in its source. Its usual one-step residual-SD warm start has a sharp positive amplitude gap for every mixed starting residual; this means it avoids the exceptionally slow balanced orbit of matched long-step BB without adding alternating controls. The exact optimizer in initial spectral energy measures a natural best-case oscillatory amplitude and quantifies startup robustness for this canonical numerical linear algebra problem.
